name: paper-lantern
summary: Warm editorial language: paper-toned surfaces, serif display type, ink-dark text and a single vermilion accent. Depth comes from hairlines rather than shadows, and shapes are crisper than the iOS default.

directives: Feel like a printed magazine, not a utility app
Keep it calm; one strong accent only
direction.rationale: Chosen over a 'soft pastel' and a 'high-contrast mono' direction. The editorial direction keeps R1's serif hierarchy and R2's restrained accent use, while avoiding R2's dense grid, which fought the reading-first content.

references.description: Synthetic reference: reading app with large serif headlines on off-white paper
Synthetic reference: finance app using one saturated accent sparingly
traits_taken: single accent reserved for primary actions

references.description: Synthetic reference: own earlier app with hairline-separated lists

signature: Serif display headlines over sans-serif body
Warm paper surfaces instead of pure white
Vermilion used only for primary actions and selection
Hairline borders, no drop shadows on content
Crisp 6pt radii instead of large rounded cards

colors.name: vermilion
colors.note: R2's accent hue rotated to match the warm palette

components.name: primaryButton
components.notes: The only filled, accent-colored control on a screen.

components.name: card
components.notes: Content container; separated by hairline, not shadow.

do: Use display/headline (serif) for titles only; everything interactive is sans-serif
Keep at most one primaryButton per screen
dont: Don't use vermilion for decoration or large backgrounds
Don't add drop shadows to cards; reserve 'floating' for sheets and popovers
Don't use pure white or pure black backgrounds

hig_deviations.what: 6pt corner radius on cards and buttons instead of ~10–12pt
hig_deviations.why: Crisper, print-like shapes are part of the signature
Editorial tone; body text stays SF Pro for legibility

estimates: R1 headline size (~34–38pt) estimated visually; set to 36
R3 hairline color sampled from list separators, width assumed 1pt
